# Rasmus Gaardskær Nielsen

Rasmus Gaardskær Nielsen is an Overlæge (senior physician), Ph.D., and clinical lecturer at Region Syddanmark who serves as a member of the steering committee for [[danibd|DANIBD]], Denmark's national database for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD)[^src1][^src2]. His role reflects the multi-disciplinary composition of DANIBD's governance structure, which draws expertise from medicine, surgery, nursing, and patient representation across all five Danish regions, alongside epidemiological and data management support from RKKP[^src1].

Nielsen's institutional base at [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] positions him within one of the five Danish healthcare regions that participate in the DANIBD network, which tracked treatment of 33,381 IBD patients between October 1, 2022, and September 30, 2023[^src1]. His clinical and academic credentials—reflected in his titles as senior physician and clinical lecturer—align with DANIBD's mandate to maintain a high-quality national registry of IBD patients treated in Danish public hospitals, a database whose coverage is estimated to exceed 90 percent based on validation against regional disease registries[^src1].
